coverage.claim: Deterministic slices reproduce declared command and derived-state lanes; they do not reproduce the full played fight.

covered.label: Movement + aim
covered.evidence: Steps bounded movement vectors, aim buckets, canvas bounds, and command checkpoints from the recorded trace.

covered.label: Combat actions
covered.evidence: Steps dash, shoot, reload, grenade, ammunition, reserve, and cooldown state without enemies.

covered.label: One derived contact enemy
covered.evidence: Derives one basic seeded chase/contact model; it is not the enemy history from the played run.

excluded.label: Actual wave spawns, formations, elites, bosses, and objective state
Projectile paths, enemy attacks, hit resolution, pickups, perks, shops, and damage parity
Exact played score, wave, health, deaths, or leaderboard authority

coverage.nextFrontier: Capture versioned enemy/projectile state and prove physics parity before raising the advisory ceiling.
